summary: Developed autonomous forklift navigation capabilities for industrial environments using ROS 2 navigation and visual SLAM in simulation and on real harware.
highlights: Integrated and calibrated sensors, implemented sensor fusion and custom filtering
Integrated Nav2 for reliable global and local navigation workflows.
Applied RTAB-Map visual SLAM for mapping, localization, and operational validation.
Connecting perception, planning, control, and field-test feedback into a maintainable autonomy stack.
Developed system monitoring and startup sequences, with comprehensive logging and data recording.
Set up Docker-based environments and automation workflows for deployment and development.
